note: D-SINK-78: how a group text splits into groups, run by BOTH tests/test_group_split.py
(the helper's split_groups and parse_m3u, through a group-title and an #EXTGRP line) and
tests/Model.test.js (the shell reads the helper's group whole, and no sink it shows a group at shows the credential).
A `;` separates groups only when no `://`, read with the control characters both mirrors
delete taken out, stands between it and the last ASCII space before it. `groups` is the
split, in order, each trimmed, empties and repeats dropped; the helper stores the first as
`group` (Ungrouped when there is none) and the list as `groups` when it holds two or more.
No group of any case may show a `q` or a `z` at any sink: nothing but the credentials holds
either. `plain` false holds a case to the two sinks that delete control characters only (a
control inside the `://` is no URL to the redactors as they are, split or not).
credentialsAreFake: Every credential here is invented and every host is under the reserved .test TLD; the username is spelt q and the password z so that any fragment of either is a leak.
